name: Crimes Against Anatomy
summary: A librarian asks you to add magical works to the collection in Ironforge. Your discoveries help expand the library’s knowledge.

sections.title: For the Collection
sections.body: The library in Ironforge seeks magical works that could benefit its collection. You can bring discoveries to the librarian, whose knowledge grows through these contributions. More works may yet be of use to the library.

faq.answer: A librarian in Ironforge asks you to bring magical works that could benefit the collection.

faq.q: Where do I bring the works?
faq.answer: Bring them to the librarian in the Library in Ironforge.
The works help expand the library’s knowledge.
